implementation: RSA in IBM z/OS® Cryptographic Services System SSL using CEX3A
description: RSA Signature Verification is a hybrid implementation supported by the IBM Crypto Express3 configured as an accelerator(CEX3A). The RSA algorithm is architected and implemented in two layers: the top layer handles the PKCS#1 padding of the results; the bottom layer deals with the modulo arithmetic and exponentiation supported by CEX3A.
